ui_6ac5d7da.message: Only one indicator request is sent per batch. The upper limit of each batch can be set to an integer from 10 to 1000. The default is 100. It rotates to detect new posts, the last 30 posts, posts to be reviewed, and historical posts. The review period can be set to 12, 24 or 48 hours, with the default being 24 hours; after this time is reached, priority will be given to entering the review round. The interface may return more; the progress will be retained when the batch is full, and the next round of demolition will continue in a small time window. Posts that have not yet been detected retain old data, and the collection time in the details can be used to determine whether they are new or old.
